arguments.prompt: In this repository (fde-station), which script enrolls a machine onto the project's private apt channel? I need: (1) the exact script file path, (2) what destination file paths it writes (apt sources.list.d file, keyring file, credential/auth file, etc.) with line numbers, (3) how the apt source entry is tied to the keyring (e.g. signed-by= reference), and (4) the exact file permission mode set on the credential/auth file, with the line number where chmod or an equivalent permission-setting call happens. Cite every claim as path:line.
